about: The errors a hosted MakersMCP gives that no kit says, as a tool result shows them, with <...> for the variable parts. A playbook may quote these; tests/playbooks.test.mjs checks every error a topic quotes against the kits, makersmcp's src and this list. Each entry names where its text is made; MakersMCP-Api's and MakersMCP-Server's tests can keep this list true. Read from MakersMCP-Api origin/main dda51b5 and MakersMCP-Server origin/main de8249b, and the three 429 texts of Kits/Start again from MakersMCP-Api origin/main b416a9a. An entry that names a commit by its subject came with that commit, which was pushed after origin/main bd34f07 and 54ed753, but for those below. The entries from MakersMCP-Api helpers/kits/video-bounds.js and version-holds.js, and run-job.js's sentence for a job with no files to use, are read from its branch feature/hosted-seven-kits at 712f2e2, and the one for a fit under a video that runs past the hour at 228d666, and the two for a length musicfit refuses as it reads its arguments at 9135762; MakersMCP-Server's sentences for a start not known are read from its branch feature/makersmcp-021 at 91bdb9c, and those for a wait that gets no word of its job at 96ba831: the commits they name were not on origin/main on 2026-11-17. The hosted texts that quote them hold once those branches are deployed, so MakersMCP-Server takes this makersmcp only after MakersMCP-Api's branch is live. There a video whose pixels are wider than they are tall counts at the size it is shown, and a length in frames under a video counts only at a given fps: the worker checks as it starts that Inferne-Deploy's run-kit media answers for its test clip as the clip is, each picture's sample_aspect_ratio included, as it does since f83fa44, and holds back the tools whose bounds read what its answer lacks or gives otherwise, caption_video, reframe_video and plan_reframe, and fit_music and analyze_music too, the whole of musicfit, when what it lacks or gives otherwise is a stream's kind or a length, or it gives no answer the worker reads. The two sentences of soundProblem for a job's sound and its seven for a fit too long for that sound say what they count, "each sound counted as long as its file states", as the change to MakersMCP-Api for musicfit 0.2.3 words them, which no branch holds on 2026-11-19: it waits as a patch, api-musicfit-023.patch, that goes over b0fdb74 with the versions MakersMCP-Api names moved to makersmcp 0.2.2 and musicfit 0.2.3, which are not committed either. b0fdb74, which is live, gives a reason of memory there that musicfit 0.2.3 no longer bears out for a video's own sound, which it reads only up to two seconds past the end of its picture, which the fit matches to a frame. The parts of them a topic quotes are the same in both. These entries are read again from origin/main once the branches are merged and that change is in them. bounds holds MakersMCP-Api's figures that the numbers of the hosted texts come from.

bounds.about: MakersMCP-Api's figures that the times, lengths and counts of the hosted captions, reframe and music topics come from, read from its branch feature/hosted-seven-kits at 712f2e2, for tests/playbooks.test.mjs to work those numbers out of. From helpers/kits/video-bounds.js: reserveSeconds is RESERVE_SECONDS; captionPixels, reframePixels and outputPixels are CAPTION_PIXELS, REFRAME_PIXELS and OUTPUT_PIXELS; soundSeconds, fitHeldSeconds, fitSeconds and fitShare are SOUND_SECONDS, FIT_HELD_SECONDS, FIT_SECONDS and FIT_SHARE; fitCopies is what fitCopies counts, the fit once and two more with a voice and with a video; fps is the frame rate framesFactor counts every time at, which scales with the frames; times are TIMES, each perPixelSecond times the 2,073,600 pixels of 1920x1080 as the seconds a second of a 1920x1080 video takes, and each grain, the words a refusal gives for footage with grain, as a number; places is PLACES. From helpers/plans/plan-settings.js: jobSeconds is timeoutSeconds's 900, a Free job's time, the shortest job.
